title: 2006 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: Mary is about to pay for five items at the grocery store. The prices of the items are \(\$7.99,\) \(\$4.99,\) \(\$2.99,\) \(\$1.99,\) and \(\$0.99.\) Mary will pay with a twenty-dollar bill. Which of the following is closest to the percentage of the \(\$20.00\) that she will receive in change?

solutions.text:
The prices total \(\$18.95,\) so the change is \(\$1.05.\) As a percentage of \(\$20.00,\) this is \[ \frac{1.05}{20}\cdot100\% = 5.25\%. \] The closest listed percentage is \(5\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Round each price to the nearest dollar to estimate the total quickly
The change is \(\$20\) minus the total; compare it to \(\$20\) as a fraction
